verdict.rationale: Kit's first-party docs cover the whole loop. Broadcasts can be drafted or scheduled to all subscribers or a subset (kit-docs-66, kit-docs-1). Audiences are targeted by segment or tag IDs, with tagging and segmentation offered as a product feature (kit-docs-2, kit-docs-25). A broadcast record carries its subject, HTML content, preview text, subscriber_filter targeting and send_at schedule (kit-docs-70), and the docs explicitly state you can 'create and send broadcasts' (kit-docs-46), with unlimited broadcasts and an email editor (kit-docs-43, kit-docs-60). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the compose-target-send flow, and in-depth documentation of the in-app visual composing and send-now experience rather than only the API surface.
